values.CP2K_PARTITION: Slurm partition the benchmark job runs in
values.CP2K_CORES_PER_NODE: cores per node; a full-node layout R x T has R * T equal to this
values.CP2K_SCAN_LAYOUTS: space-separated full-node R x T layouts the scan stage times
values.CP2K_PYTHON: front-end Python (3.8+, no numpy needed) that runs the helper scripts
values.CP2K_SRUN_MPI: srun flag selecting the MPI plugin the CP2K build needs, e.g. --mpi=pmix
values.CP2K_SMOKE_LAYOUTS: two full-node layouts the smoke stage runs (default SMOKE_LAYOUTS)
